title: lepisorus boninensis
intro: Lepisorus boninensis, commonly known as Bonin fern or Christmas fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a non-vascular, vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, known for its distinctive fronds and potential health benefits. Lepisorus boninensis has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and oxidative stress, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
